title: Recruiter
shortPitch: Grow your career as Recruiter in recruitment / talent acquisition.

description.overview: We are looking for a capable Recruiter to join our Recruitment / Talent Acquisition team and contribute directly to our growth in Human Resources (HR).

Fast-growing company with rapid regional expansion
Modern office with free lunch and snacks
responsibilities: Handle core recruitment / talent acquisition activities aligned with company goals and standards.
Process documentation and knowledge sharing, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all deliverables.
Coordinate quality standards and process compliance and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.

Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Good stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Good command of English (written and spoken)
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

benefits.label: Flexible working hours and hybrid option
Holiday and Tet bonus
Laptop and equipment provided

Parking allowance / shuttle bus support
16-18 days of paid annual leave

description.overview: We're hiring a HR Manager who is passionate about general hr management and ready to make an impact in a growing Human Resources (HR) organization.
topReasonsToJoin: 16 days annual leave, above market standard
Competitive salary reviewed twice a year
Work directly with international clients and cross-border projects
responsibilities: Define and manage core general hr management activities aligned with company goals and standards.
Set direction and KPIs for quality standards and process compliance, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all deliverables.
Oversee end-to-end planning and resource allocation and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.
Oversee end-to-end day-to-day operations related to the role to support smooth execution and timely delivery.
Set direction and KPIs for stakeholder communication and updates, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
Oversee end-to-end a team of professionals, setting clear goals and supporting their development.
requirements: 6+ years of experience, including 2-3 years in a management role relevant to the HR Manager role.
Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Proactive mindset with a can-do attitude
Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking
Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.

benefits.label: Recognition programs and quarterly awards
Parking allowance / shuttle bus support
Team building activities and company trips
Free lunch, coffee and snacks at the office
Opportunity to work with international partners
Holiday and Tet bonus

Ability to work independently and under pressure
Good command of English (written and spoken)
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
